_comment: HARD PRUNES (2026-10-28): the SAME position with MTG_CYCLONE_SEED_PLANS and MTG_CYCLONE_CYCLER_RULE ON. The
seed no longer pins Curator's scry j; the provider's walk-aware scry decides at resolution and must bottom the Street
Wraith on top (a non-Eldrazi creature would stop the walk), so the walk still reaches Emrakul in ROUND 3. The original
Unpredictable Cyclone phase 3: Curator of Mysteries' scry resolves BEFORE the Cyclone walk, and its
disposition is SEARCHED (the cycle seed's pin j). Round 3, main 1, Cyclone + Curator (not sick) + three
Islands, Street Wraith in hand; the library top is Street Wraith, Emrakul. With j = 0 the walk hits the
Wraith on top (a 3/4); with j = 1 the scry bottoms it and the walk reaches Emrakul -> extra turn. The
opponent at 15: Curator attacks for 4 this turn (11), then Emrakul 15 + Curator 4 in the extra turn ->
ROUND 3. The j = 0 line cannot kill before round 5.
